body:
I took Wellbutrin 600mg and 5g gaba amino acid over the course of one day. I felt a little high, more talkative and very productive.
When I went to bed I noticed I had a rash all over my face. I researched it and it was probably something called choline ultarica. I thought I better take a smaller dosage the next day.
I then laid down to sleep and I saw a beautiful light matrix hover in the air. It  was gliding through the air rotating and spinning. It then spun towards me, the light matrix flew through my head and I felt it touch me. I was very calm and collected, I considered what it could be. I spoke gently to it asking what it wants and if I could help it.
This went on for a very long time. I realised I could control the movement a tiny bit with opening my eyes and tensing my forehead while gazing. The matrix of light changed into many shapes, was 3d most of the time. It opened a small vortex in the air, that I tried to push my consciousness through. That worked a little.
As it seemed I had more control, I thought it maybe a hallucination. But when the matrix hit me I felt very strong feeling of touch in the area it touched me. It also moved so gracefully, sometimes slowly, sometimes quickly, sometimes hovering; that I did not think it was a hallucination. I tested it by requesting it knock something over in my room. It flew to a small bottle and I heard a tiny tiny sound, but nothing happened.
Many experiences with colour and different forms of light occurred. Frankly speaking it felt almost spiritual.
